definitions.explanation: The surgeon who performs or leads a surgical operation. Distinguished from assistant surgeons or other members of the surgical team.

examples.japanese: {執刀医|しっとうい}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
{経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な{執刀医|しっとうい}が{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{担当|たんとう}した。
examples.english: An experienced surgeon performed the operation.

examples.japanese: {患者|かんじゃ}の{家族|かぞく}は{手術|しゅじゅつ}{前|まえ}に{執刀医|しっとうい}から{説明|せつめい}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The patient's family received an explanation from the lead surgeon before the operation.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {執刀|しっとう} (holding the scalpel; performing surgery) and {医|い} (doctor). Used in medical contexts and news reports about surgeries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {執刀医|しっとうい}が{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{行|おこな}う (the surgeon performs the operation)
- {執刀医|しっとうい}を{務|つと}める (to serve as the operating surgeon)

RELATED WORDS:
- {外科医|げかい}: surgeon (general term)
- {主治医|しゅじい}: attending physician
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgery, operation
